summary: The registrant, PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia Tbk, filed a Form 6-K reporting a change in the composition of its Audit Committee, effective June 17, 2026. The filing discloses a new committee chair and members, all independent commissioners and independent members, to comply with Indonesian Financial Services Authority regulations. This is a routine corporate governance update mandated by local rules, similar to a US Form 8-K Item 5.02 disclosure. No deal terms, prices, stakeholder actions, or strategic changes are involved. The filing does not trigger a special-situation classification; it is purely an administrative reporting requirement.
